stories.title: Contre toute attente, Alex Saab, un proche de Maduro, plaide coupable de blanchiment d'argent aux Etats-Unis

en.title: Against all expectations, Alex Saab, a close associate of Maduro, pleads guilty to money laundering in the United States
en.summary: Alex Saab, a former Venezuelan minister and key figure under Nicolas Maduro, pleaded guilty to money laundering in a U.S. federal court after agreeing to cooperate with investigators. His cooperation could potentially harm former president Maduro, despite Saab's previous not guilty plea.

stories.title: La guerre contre l'Iran a coûté 38 milliards de dollars aux Etats-Unis

en.title: War against Iran has cost the United States 38 billion dollars
en.summary: The U.S. war against Iran has cost 38 billion dollars since its beginning, according to the non-partisan Congressional Budget Office estimate through early August.

stories.title: Des sénateurs démocrates accusent Kash Patel, le directeur du FBI, d'avoir intimidé des journalistes

en.title: Democratic senators accuse Kash Patel, the FBI director, of intimidating journalists
en.summary: Democratic senators accused FBI Director Kash Patel during a contentious congressional hearing of misusing his position to intimidate journalists. Patel denied the allegations and highlighted the FBI's record on crime reduction.

stories.title: Feelgood-Falle – Das Wellness-Paradox: Gesund, getrimmt, gestresst

en.title: Feelgood trap – The wellness paradox: Healthy, fit, stressed
en.summary: A new study demonstrates that social pressure and the desire for well-being are increasing among the population.

stories.title: Le réseau ferroviaire néerlandais paralysé plusieurs heures par des actes attribués à un sabotage

en.title: Dutch railway network paralyzed for several hours by acts attributed to sabotage
en.summary: Train traffic across much of the Netherlands was severely disrupted on Tuesday due to coordinated sabotage acts on railway lines, affecting numerous services including the overnight Amsterdam-Zurich connection.

stories.title: Eishockey National League: ZSC siegt trotz dreimaligem Rückstand

en.title: Ice Hockey National League: ZSC wins despite three-goal deficit
en.summary: ZSC Lions defeated SCB 5:3 in the National League season opener, recording the best current starting streak for any team. Defending champion Fribourg lost to Biel 2:4.

stories.title: Jason Arday, une victime sacrificielle pour en finir avec les politiques d’inclusion

en.title: Jason Arday, a sacrificial victim to end inclusion policies
en.summary: A young Cambridge professor of African origin died by suicide in August following a media campaign that exposed plagiarism in his career. The piece examines moral responsibility for his death.

stories.title: Round-up National League – ZSC siegt trotz 3-maligem Rückstand – Biel düpiert den Meister

en.title: National League round-up – ZSC wins despite 3-goal deficit – Biel upsets champion
en.summary: ZSC Lions defeated SCB 5:3, while defending champion Gottéron lost 2:4 to Biel in the season opener.

stories.title: Ewigkeitschemikalien PFAS – Trotz Nachfrage: Ständerat lehnt Deklarationspflicht für PFAS ab

en.title: Forever Chemicals PFAS – Despite Demand: Upper House Rejects Mandatory Disclosure for PFAS
en.summary: Two political proposals called for mandatory disclosure requirements for PFAS chemicals. A majority in the Swiss upper house voted against implementing such a requirement.

stories.title: «Ewigkeitschemikalien»: Der Ständerat verschafft den Bauern Zeit, um sich auf strengere PFAS-Regeln einzustellen

en.title: "Forever Chemicals": Upper House Gives Farmers Time to Adapt to Stricter PFAS Rules
en.summary: A centrist upper house member from canton St. Gallen advocated for a more pragmatic approach to PFAS regulations, giving the agricultural sector additional time to adjust to stricter rules.

stories.title: Aucune trêve en vue: les Etats-Unis et la Chine sont engagés dans une course sans merci à la domination mondiale de l’IA

en.title: No Truce in Sight: The United States and China Are Engaged in a Relentless Race for Global AI Dominance
en.summary: The United States and China are competing intensely for artificial intelligence dominance, though both superpowers increasingly recognize similar risks from these technologies. Despite shared concerns, meaningful cooperation between them remains unlikely.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis reconnaissent pour la première fois avoir déployé des armes dans l’espace

en.title: The United States Acknowledges for the First Time Having Deployed Weapons in Space
en.summary: The United States admitted to possessing weapons in space, representing a new development in the military space capabilities race among major powers. Both Russia and China immediately condemned the disclosure.

stories.title: Einheitliche Berufe in Europa: Die EU will dies endlich ermöglichen, Verbände melden Protest an

en.title: Unified professions in Europe: The EU finally wants to enable this, associations protest
en.summary: The EU aims to standardize professions across Europe to make it easier for EU citizens and Swiss residents to accept jobs abroad and deepen the internal market.

stories.title: Der Ölschock trifft die Schweiz weniger als andere Länder. Doch wieso wird Diesel deutlich teurer als Benzin?

en.title: Oil shock hits Switzerland less than other countries. But why is diesel becoming significantly more expensive than petrol?
en.summary: Switzerland experiences less impact from rising energy prices compared to other nations. However, diesel prices are rising faster than petrol prices due to greater scarcity in the diesel market.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Verwaltungsrat von Migros Online stellt sich neu auf

en.title: BRIEF UPDATES - Economy: Board of Migros Online restructures
en.summary: The Migros Online board is undergoing reorganization.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Die Marktschreier rufen die globale Krise aus – und dann passiert nichts», sagt der Präsident des Private-Equity-Riesen Blackstone

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Market criers announce global crisis – and then nothing happens," says Blackstone private equity giant's president
en.summary: Jonathan Gray, president of Blackstone, one of the largest AI boom investors, dismisses bubble concerns as unfounded and addresses growing anxiety among private investors.

stories.title: Die Schweiz gerät wegen der OECD-Mindeststeuer ins Hintertreffen. Zwei Professoren wollen Abhilfe schaffen

en.title: Switzerland falls behind due to OECD minimum tax. Two professors want to provide a remedy
en.summary: Switzerland has become less tax-attractive for large corporations, particularly since the USA withdrew from the OECD minimum tax agreement. A new expert report suggests potential countermeasures to address this disadvantage.
